rawContent: It’s really kind of painful to contemplate. All the enthusiasm over #BlackLivesMatter this summer, all the marches, all the support and rhetoric — was it all only performance art? #SlateReads

Oh I forgot some of my train of thought regarding #BlackLivesMatter and engagement with white women this summer: with the #COVID19 lock down, there have been epic numbers of free, anti-racist webinars available. #SlateReads

Now I’m wondering if those there were “looking cool.”
